# pr\-reviewer

```go
import "github.com/blanketops/environments-bots/cmd/pr-reviewer"
```

Command pr\-reviewer reviews pull requests against the repository's pull request template and issue templates, in the style of PR Agent.

\\tpr\-reviewer review review a pull request and post review comments

GitHub is reached with the token in GH\_TOKEN \(or GITHUB\_TOKEN\), normally an installation token of the BlanketOps Environments PR Reviewer App.
